$schema_doc: Each single tweet is one object. The schedule-tweets skill picks up the first tweet with status='pending' and posts it via Chrome, attaching an image if image_id and image_path are populated. Status flow: 'pending' -> 'posting' -> 'posted' -> 'failed' (or 'skipped-too-long' if char_count > 25,000). The hook field is the first line/sentence of the tweet, used for filtering and engagement analysis. image_id is an 8-char hex UUID linking to a file in schedule-tweets/images/; image_path is the relative path to that file. views is captured 48+ hours after posting (along with views_captured_at). url is set when the tweet is live. Migrated from tweets.csv on 2026-05-12.
